column1: # Original-byte manifest for rc2-siblingleak (driver solar 0479b90a, base solidity-lean 49d1d7f5).
# Columns: path in this directory, sha256 of the bytes as first written on the run host, sha256 of
# the committed file, who wrote it, transform applied before commit.
# Transform "home" = the publish step replaced every "/home/hand/" with "~/". The original files
# contain no "~/", so "sed 's#~/#/home/hand/#g'" on the committed file gives the original bytes
# exactly; check-manifest.sh checks every row that way.
